sizes.revision: V16 indexed fold and recessed cross-rivet candidate
sizes.assembly: Insert bare pin and actual coil before rear cap. Attach cap hardware. Slide knob onto stem, align cross holes, insert a one-headed preform then upset the other rivet head in its recess. Final formed shape is modelled; upsetting and tool access not qualified. Pin service requires removing the rivet.
limits: One local candidate; no native Fusion reconstruction
Metal pin and rivet are intended; final grade, upsetting strain, tolerances, coatings and proof loads unqualified
Index holes define geometric storage locking only; actual spring return friction bearing strength wear and pinch access need validation
No hard travel stops outside engaged index positions
No physical or acoustic or sensory acceptance pass
